card.name: The word information after prescribing
card.fires_on: The word "information" right after "prescribing" in cross-references such as "see full prescribing information". It also fires on a few other nouns completing a fixed title, such as "Wikipedia Commons" and "Sports Illustrated for Kids".

modes.label: Prescribing information
modes.description: "information" completes the phrase "prescribing information" in a pointer to another label.
modes.example: Refer to carboplatin prescribing<< information>> for additional information.

modes.label: Other fixed titles
modes.description: The last word of a set name or title, such as a site or magazine.
modes.example: Sports Illustrated for<< Kids>> P.O. Box 60

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look like unrelated code and word-piece fragments.
card.plain: It marks the word "information" that finishes "prescribing information" when a label points the reader to another label.
